versions.name: Oso Lake Scout Camp
versions.address: 21131 Los Alisos Boulevard, Rancho Santa Margarita, CA 92688
versions.summary: An Orange County Council short-term camp beside a lake within O'Neill Regional Park near Rancho Santa Margarita, California, offering day-camp and weekend unit camping with archery, fishing, and kayaking on its campsites.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the camp's own site and the Orange County Council camp listing, which confirm Oso Lake Scout Camp as an active OCC day- and weekend-camping property. Street address corrected from the source's 28092 Oso Parkway to the camp's own 21131 Los Alisos Boulevard, Rancho Santa Margarita. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active operating status verified against the camp site and council listing; camp_type/program_types classified as a short-term camp with a Cub day-camp program; features unsurveyed.
